summary: 新規dependencyはinstall前にregistry存在・publisher・履歴・repositoryを決定論的に検証し、default deny/owner承認、lockfile・provenance検証、install scriptはsecretなしsandboxで実行し、公式docs retrievalで名前生成をgroundする

evidence.summary: USENIX Security 25研究でdeterministic検証を含む緩和を評価、evidence-supported/high
OIDC trusted publishingとprovenance attestation（public repoは既定生成）で出所検証可能
network.allowedDomainsでregistry.npmjs.org等へ限定し、NPM_TOKENはmaskで注入可能

dependency-verification (public, reputation emerging): read SKILL.md on skills.sh: its rule is 'a package name the model produced is a claim, not a fact; the registry is the fact — verify before you install', backed by the Spracklen et al. hallucination-rate measurements and the huggingface-cli proof-of-concept, which is this remedy's registry-verification step.

applies_when: Agentがnpm install/依存追加を提案・実行する
not_applicable_when: 依存追加を人間だけが行い、Agentは提案しない運用

expected_effect.primary: 存在しない/typosquat packageの取得率をほぼ0に

cost: 数分（AGENTS.md規則+lockfile方針）、CI検証は数時間
known_failure_modes: 名前のもっともらしさで承認

alternates.why_not_primary: Broader OWASP A03:2025 supply-chain checklist that explicitly delegates license and secret concerns elsewhere; it frames the risk but does not give the pre-install registry-verification procedure.
481 installs, but it audits dependencies already present rather than gating a new install.

Read this pass: deterministic collector scripts measure version-matched advisories, abandoned or archived upstreams, npm publisher concentration and install-time script execution, and it refuses to report when it measured nothing — established (Trail of Bits, 5.9K installs) and the strongest public evidence-based dependency check, but it audits the tree a project already has instead of verifying a new package before installation.
